title: ModPACKED
description: A simple modpack put together for me and my friends to mess around! Contains a ton of features put together to make a palatable modpack!
body:
**ModPACKED** is a feature-rich, adventure-ready modpack built for friends who want a little bit of everything!  
Blending creativity, exploration, technology, and performance optimizations, ModPACKED offers a balanced experience that’s easy to jump into — whether you’re building grand cities, automating complex factories, or simply going on epic adventures.  

🌎 **Key Features**:
- Enhanced building with *Chipped*, *Rechiseled*, and *Immersive Paintings*
- Expanded exploration with *Waystones*, *Alex’s Caves*, and *Northstar*
- Massive tech and engineering possibilities with *Create* mods and *Mekanism*
- Huge variety of new weapons and tools for PvP and PvE fun
- Lightweight performance boosts (*Clumps*, *FerriteCore*, *FPS Reducer*) to keep it running smoothly even on older machines
- Easy LAN hosting with *e4mc* and server prep with *Chunky*

Built for Minecraft **1.20.1** using **Forge**, ModPACKED is perfect for casual sessions, long-term survival, or even private servers with friends.  
  
⚙️ **Over 170 mods** carefully curated and optimized — recommended at least **4GB RAM** for best experience.

Gather your friends, hop into a world, and make your own adventures with **ModPACKED**!
